KHDK Electronics browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz octave fuzz octave fuzz (1 octave up) browse by enclosure pedal KHDK Electronics Unicorn Blood - Octave Fuzz Published on January 20, 2019 KHDK Electronics octave fuzz (1 octave up) pedal Information KHDK Electronics "Buckle up Earthlings, welcome to immortality!" -  Controlled Sonic Mayhem in a Candy-Colored Box of Magic Technology Unicorn Blood is an octave fuzz pedal like no other: trippy, hyper-versatile, a true miracle worker. It's retro at heart, taking an iconic sound of an unforgettable era and beaming it straight into 2018 with modern features like True Bypass, Octatone and additional EQ controls. Step aboard a rainbow-colored sonic ride, expand your creative horizon and harness the rush reserved for those who partake of Unicorn Blood. Each pedal ships with a fragrant bag of Dark Matter's iconic espresso blend, the Unicorn Blood coffee. Vintage-voiced yet modern, Unicorn Blood fuzz brings the best tones of the 60s and 70s into the modern day. It entraps a classic retro fuzz, elevating it with tweakable features to create your own tonal blend. Massive Sound Range and Versatility Unicorn Blood thinks of you as a player in various situations. The 3 switches - Fat, Boost and Sludge - give you a massive sound range and versatility.  In combination with the Fat switch, the Sludge will give you a low-mid growl to always keep you on top of the mix. Combined with the Boost and Fat, you can get yourself right where you want to be frequency-wise. Stack it or Run it Dry It can hold its own on a dry pedalboard: flip on the Sludge to sound massive. The Fat boosts your mids and, together with the Boost, it will deliver a sound you'd normally need at least 3 other pedals to achieve. The pedal stacks just as beautifully. Turn the boost off and add an overdrive or a booster to turn the Unicorn Blood into a miracle worker. That's when it truly reaches its spazzy, vicious potential that will blow your mind. Intuitive and Highly Playable With any Setup Independent of your setup, the Unicorn Blood will make your sound outstanding. The switches are right where they belong, making it a highly intuitive pedal. Feeling lost? Flip a switch and it will get you right back. Feel it spin on its own? Stack it and it becomes huge.
